limits: QEMU validates rebuilt userspace with generated H.264 input; it does not emulate the ISP, VPU, sensors or motor.
Replay controls are simulations, replay audio is PCMA silence, and replay has no JPEG/speaker backend.
This is a local-services implementation, not complete OEM feature parity. See README.md for unsupported features.
The SDK tests intentionally inject a cleanup failure; the corresponding error log is expected.
The old uClibc loader can warn about the host ld.so.cache format under QEMU; test processes still exit successfully.
